title: PROPERTY_OUT
description: Output contract of Property Engine (07_PROPERTY_ENGINE.md). Consumed by Google Engine, House Engine, Render Engine.

property_id.description: Canonical property identifier, join key across every engine payload.

title.description: Cleaned title. Promotional hyperbole, phone numbers, and Line IDs must already be stripped.

price_thb.description: Plain number, no comma separators. Null if price could not be parsed (do not guess).

style_tag.description: Must match this enum exactly. Default to CONTEMPORARY when style cannot be determined -- never invent a new style name.

raw_address.description: Address exactly as written in the source listing. Must not be geocoded or inferred here -- that is Google Engine's job.

highlight_features.description: 3-5 factual selling points. No pricing info, no contact info, no promotional language.

x-error-codes.ERR_PROP_01: Invalid Price Format -- stop processing, status FAILED, escalate to human-in-the-loop
x-error-codes.ERR_PROP_PARSE: LLM response was not valid JSON

x-hard-rules: No Hallucination -- never invent data not present in source text.
Exact Matching -- style_tag must be one of the enum values, never a new label.
Strip promotional hyperbole and personal contact info before this record leaves the engine.
Never let phone numbers/Line IDs leak into title or highlight_features.
